snippet.title: Yuujin no Furi Furi Girls [遊人のふりふりガールズ] Game Sample - SNES/SFC
snippet.description:
Original Air Date: April 11th, 2009

This is a board game where a beatiful woman who resides in Princess Land wants four girls to compete against each other and monsters to ultimately rack up JL and become a "Furi-Furi Girl" or something of that nature. Lucy, Midori, Alice and May (Mei) are chosen for this mission. You'll encounter a variety of obstacles such as UFOs that can move you to random locations, red and yellow tiles which have the potential to produce numerous hazards, and monsters that move around the board to stop you. You need to reach a certain point on the board with a gold key to end the game, but a boss monster has it initially. If you're lucky, you can get a projectile to destroy him without fighting him.

Speaking of fights, youll be fighting a lot. Battles are fought via Janken (or Jan-ken-pon for the politically correct), which means little skill and a lot of luck. You can build your stats if you're lucky enough and even minor increases will make you much harder to defeat in battle. The interesting thing about the game is that losing takes people to the hellish side of the board, where characters constantly lose their JL (points of sorts) and experience much misfortune. They can leave that side of the board in several ways that I won't discuss here. 

The game lasts a looooooooooong time because the computer can get the key and won't go to the exit but instead stay around to fight other players due to questionable AI. A good strategy is to walk back and forth trying to land on blue squares (good fortune), yellow squares and treasure chest in an attempt to build your stats so you can easily overcome any impedement when you get the key. This game is interesting, but it's not for everyone. Enjoy.
